We priced the same three nights on both sides of Osaka Station.
Walking 12 minutes saved ¥9,474 👇

🏨 Hotel Monterey, by Osaka Station:
¥34,394 for 3 nights.

🌿 Quintessa, near Nakazakicho:
¥24,920 for the same nights.

📅 14–17 Dec 2026, 1 adult, Booking.com.

🚶 The catch: about 800 m on foot.
A taxi is about ¥600–800 each way.

✅ Small bag? Walk it.
Early trains every day? Pay for the station.
